s0e7d3a3a1ed9ef: 在我们持续优化云资源的过程中，很高兴地宣布，在增强 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service（EKS）上的 GPU 共享方面取得了重大进展。通过实施内存限制，我们确保 EKS 上每个支持 GPU 的 Pod 都被分配了一定量的内存，防止过度使用，提高了整体系统效率。此次更新将为我们的 GPU 密集型应用降低成本并提升性能，最终增强我们在市场上的竞争优势。

sf5fcdb91aada92: HAMi is the abbreviation of the Heterogeneous AI Computerization Middle, a “one-stop” structure designed to manage the Heterogeneous AI computing equipment in the Kubernetes cluster, providing shared capacity and task-level resources for the Heterogeneous AI devices. HAMi works to increase the utilization of the Heterogeneous computing equipment in the Kubernetes cluster by providing a uniform reuse interface for different types of heterogeneous devices. It is currently a CCF sandbox project and has been incorporated into the CNCF CNAI category technology profile.
sf3db05795e23f3: Figure 1: HAMi Heterogeneous computing support architecture
s2e5b431246618f: Dynamia provides flexible, reliable, demand-driven and flexible GPU virtualization and heterogeneous calculations and integrated management of global solutions based on CNCF Hami. It can be deployed in a pluginized, lightweight, non-intrusive manner in any publicly owned, private or mixed cloud environment and supports the Heterogenous chips of NVIDIA, Ascend, MetaX, Cambricon, Hygon, Moore Threads, Biren, etc.
